# truenas_boot_environment (Data Source)

Fetches information about a TrueNAS boot environment by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Boot environment name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether this boot environment is activated (will be booted next).
- `active` (Boolean) Whether this boot environment is currently booted.
- `dataset` (String) ZFS dataset backing this boot environment.
- `id` (String) Boot environment name (used as Terraform ID).
- `keep` (Boolean) Whether this boot environment is protected from automatic pruning.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Space used by this boot environment, in bytes.
